description: A horizontal milestone gallery where the focused card opens wide on a ruled track, its neighbours fold into narrow spines, and every move lands with a soft spring and a short squeeze.
interactionNotes: The track moves inside its own frame and never takes over the page. The wheel walks one milestone at a time while there is still a card in that direction; a horizontal drag follows the pointer, the arrow keys step through the track (mirrored in right-to-left) and Home and End jump to the ends. Clicking a narrow card pulls it to the centre. The ruler under the cards slides with the focus, and under prefers-reduced-motion the track jumps instead of gliding.

props.items: Milestones in order; each one carries a year, a title and optionally a caption, an image URL and a link.
props.height: Height of a focused card, px.
props.openWidth: Width of the focused card, px.
props.shutWidth: Width of a card that is not focused, px.
props.radius: Corner radius at rest, px; it opens up while the track moves.
props.dim: How far the cards away from the focus sink into the plate, 0 to 1.
props.rulerStep: Distance between two milestones on the ruler, px.
props.showRuler: Draws the ruler with its ticks and years.
props.background: Colour of the plate; it also tints the cards that fall behind.
props.textColor: Colour of the year and the title.
props.labelColor: Colour of the years on the ruler.
props.markerColor: Colour of the centre marker and of the year you are standing on.

tips: The cards work without images: every one falls back to a drawn placeholder in its own tone, so the component ships with no asset and never requests one.
On a phone the focused card takes the width of the frame and the height is capped at 1.4 times that width; raise `height` and the cap follows.
The wheel only takes over while there is still a card to move to; at either end the page keeps scrolling normally.
Direction comes from the computed style, so the same file reads right-to-left in a Persian layout and left-to-right anywhere else. Nothing is mirrored by hand.
`dim` sets the depth: 0 flattens the row, and above 0.7 the neighbours almost disappear into the plate.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the track jumps straight to the chosen milestone and the spring never runs.
Give every card a `year`: the ruler labels come from it, and a missing one leaves an empty tick.
